task: Move the ball away from the door before you take the key. Try not to drop the key while the door is still closed. Whenever you are holding the key, try to have the door open at that moment or open it afterwards. Then open the door with the key and pick up the box in the other room.

calls.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: The task says 'Then open the door with the key and pick up the box in the other room.' — an imperative that commands opening the door and orders it before picking up the box. The clauses contain a hard Existence(target_picked_up) but no order clause, so the machine (see u0: blocker_moved&door_open&target_picked_up -> u1 with the same reward as picking up the box without the door ever being opened) accepts finishing the task with door_open never true. The other clauses (hard Precedence(blocker_moved, has_door_key), soft Response(has_door_key, door_open), soft Absence(key_lost)) match the task wording and priorities.
